candidates.change_summary: Change the condition so payout branch happens when random == 1 instead of random == 0, which alters whether pot is reset on some calls.
Remove the pot reset so pot is not set to zero after a win, changing pot's value after play when the branch executes.

Apply the fee transfer to pot instead of transferring to bank, keeping pot unchanged by payout but altering pot value when transfer subtraction later occurs (here we transfer fee to bank and also decrement pot), resulting in different pot after play.
Insert an extra pot increment before randomness so pot increases by an additional TICKET_AMOUNT on every play, changing pot observed after call.
Change the require to allow any msg.value (remove the equality check), so pot may increase by different amounts and thus pot after play can differ.
Change the random condition to `random == 1` so winnings are paid when random equals 1 instead of 0.
Remove the fee transfer so the bank is not paid when a win occurs.
Transfer the entire pot to the sender on win (remove fee deduction), so sender receives pot instead of pot - FEE_AMOUNT.
Update pot accumulation to exclude the incoming ticket so pot isn't increased by the ticket before potential payout.
Set pot to zero before transferring winnings, which may change the amount sent to the player (causing them to receive zero).
